Independent beta-moment compression gave 20 exact rational squared-singular-value identities for the pair t,t² over four weights and five frequencies; at α=0,m=0 the square is 1/2700, and m³ times the block singular value is 3.994006 at α=0,m=10000, tending to 4.
correctness.rationale: Rotation gives a scalar frequency −1 block and degree-one polynomial compression under Beta(m+1,α+1) at every m≥0. If X,Y are the compressions of t,t², the sole Jacobi excursion across the projection gives Y=X²+a₂²diag(0,1), so the skew block [X,Y] has off-diagonal magnitude a₁a₂². For b=α+1 the moments of m(1−t) converge with O(m⁻¹) errors to Gamma(b) moments, whose first two monic orthogonal norm squares are b and 2b(b+1); this independently gives m a₁→√b and m²a₂²→2(b+1). Beta moments with the explicit centered normalized linear polynomial bound compressions of (1−t)^q by O(m⁻q), including the C³ Taylor remainders at q=3. After removing scalar terms, all remainder commutators are O(m⁻⁴), and the cubic part is W[X,Y]/2. Each nonzero skew block contributes two singular values, producing factor 8 on rearrangement. Compactness and both Schatten assertions follow by counting and power summation, with necessity only for W≠0.
residual_risks: The exact finite identities verify model-pair normalization, not the general C³ estimate. Scope is the full order-two space with real radial symbols; no necessity is shown at p=1/4 for W=0.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Taking n=2 and the absolute value of the opposite jet convention recovers the frozen positive coefficient and threshold. Qualitative scalar matrix limits by themselves give no rate and are not the ground for failure.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: At Δ=0 this bound is O(m⁻⁴) outright; counting at most two singular values per block gives O(j⁻⁴), limit zero after multiplying by j³, and S_p for p>1/4. For Δ≠0 the exact positive asymptotic gives the weak endpoint and failure of strong endpoint directly (the comparison also states a logarithmic residue). Thus neither limiting case supplies an uncovered claim.
